The database schema named "schemabench_0192" contains 21 tables. The primary key of each table is used for unique identification.
The 'author' table represents authors of books. It has columns for 'name' (a string of up to 80 characters), 'picture' (a string of up to 2047 characters), and 'summary' (a string of up to 2047 characters).
The 'book' table represents books. It has columns for 'product_id' (an integer), 'name' (a string of up to 255 characters), 'description' (a string of up to 2047 characters), 'price' (a numeric value with 14 digits and 2 decimal places), 'publisher_price' (a numeric value with 8 digits and 2 decimal places), 'sold_count' (an integer), 'isbn' (a string of up to 10 characters), 'series' (a string of up to 255 characters), 'format' (a string of up to 255 characters), and 'pages' (an integer).
The 'coupon' table represents coupons. It has columns for 'coupon_code' (a string of up to 80 characters), 'is_percent' (a boolean), 'savings' (a numeric value with 8 digits and 2 decimal places), 'valid_from' (a timestamp), and 'valid_to' (a timestamp).
The 'storeuser' table represents users of the store. It has columns for 'username' (a string of up to 255 characters), 'first_name' (a string of up to 255 characters), 'last_name' (a string of up to 255 characters), 'email' (a string of up to 255 characters), 'address' (a string of up to 255 characters), 'picture' (a string of up to 255 characters), 'time_created' (a timestamp), and 'time_last_login' (a timestamp).
The 'product' table represents products. It has columns for 'product_id' (an integer), 'name' (a string of up to 255 characters), 'description' (a string of up to 2047 characters), 'price' (a numeric value with 14 digits and 2 decimal places), 'publisher_price' (a numeric value with 8 digits and 2 decimal places), 'sold_count' (an integer).
The 'publisher' table represents publishers. It has columns for 'name' (a string of up to 80 characters), 'address' (a string of up to 2047 characters), 'email' (a string of up to 255 characters), 'phone' (a big integer), 'institution_number' (a small integer), 'branch_number' (an integer), and 'account_number' (a big integer).
The 'role' table represents roles. It has columns for 'role_id' (an integer), 'name' (a string of up to 25 characters), and 'description' (a string of up to 2047 characters).
The 'warehouse' table represents warehouses. It has columns for 'warehouse_name' (a string of up to 80 characters), 'address' (a string of up to 255 characters), 'phone' (a big integer), and 'area_sqft' (an integer).
The 'storeorder' table represents orders. It has columns for 'order_number' (an integer), 'username' (a string of up to 255 characters), 'status' (a string of up to 80 characters), 'billed_to' (a string of up to 2047 characters), 'shipped_to' (a string of up to 2047 characters), 'time_placed' (a timestamp), and 'delivery_fee' (a numeric value with 8 digits and 2 decimal places).
The 'cart' table represents shopping carts. It has columns for 'username' (a string of up to 255 characters) and 'last_edited' (a timestamp).
The 'book_genre' table represents book genres. It has columns for 'product_id' (an integer), 'genre' (a string of up to 80 characters), and is linked to the 'book' table via a foreign key.
The 'product_image' table represents product images. It has columns for 'product_id' (an integer), and 'image' (a string of up to 2047 characters).
The 'product_tag' table represents product tags. It has columns for 'product_id' (an integer), and 'tag' (a string of up to 80 characters).
The 'cart_coupon' table represents cart coupons. It has columns for 'username' (a string of up to 255 characters) and 'coupon_code' (a string of up to 80 characters), and is linked to the 'cart' and 'coupon' tables via foreign keys.
The 'cart_product' table represents products in carts. It has columns for 'username' (a string of up to 255 characters), 'product_id' (an integer), 'quantity' (an integer), and is linked to the 'cart' and 'product' tables via foreign keys.
The 'order_coupon' table represents order coupons. It has columns for 'order_number' (an integer) and 'coupon_code' (a string of up to 80 characters), and is linked to the 'storeorder' and 'coupon' tables via foreign keys.
The 'order_product' table represents products in orders. It has columns for 'order_number' (an integer), 'product_id' (an integer), 'quantity' (an integer), and 'price' (a numeric value with 14 digits and 2 decimal places), and is linked to the 'storeorder' and 'product' tables via foreign keys.
The 'publishes' table represents book-publisher relationships. It has columns for 'product_id' (an integer), 'publisher_name' (a string of up to 80 characters), 'year_published' (a small integer), 'reorder_threshold' (an integer), and 'commission_percent' (a numeric value with 5 digits and 3 decimal places), and is linked to the 'publisher' table via a foreign key.
The 'stored_in' table represents product-warehouse relationships. It has columns for 'product_id' (an integer), 'warehouse_name' (a string of up to 80 characters), 'stock' (an integer), and 'aisle' (an integer), and is linked to the 'warehouse' table via a foreign key.
The 'user_role' table represents user-role relationships. It has columns for 'username' (a string of up to 255 characters), 'role_id' (an integer), and is linked to the 'storeuser' and 'role' tables via foreign keys.
The 'writes' table represents author-book relationships. It has columns for 'product_id' (an integer), 'author_name' (a string of up to 80 characters), and is linked to the 'book' and 'author' tables via foreign keys.

1) Background / Context:

The project involves developing an online bookstore that offers a wide selection of books and related accessories. This platform aims to provide an engaging and user-friendly experience for both customers wanting to purchase books and business stakeholders managing the store's operations. 

2) Objectives:

- Facilitate the purchase and sale of books online.
- Allow users to manage their shopping experience and orders seamlessly.
- Enable store owners to maintain and manage inventory efficiently.
- Provide publishers with tools to manage their stock and receive commissions.

3) Stakeholders & Users:

- Customers: Individuals who wish to browse, purchase, and track books.
- Owners: Individuals responsible for inventory management, sales tracking, and platform administration.
- Publishers: Partners who publish books, manage stock, and receive commissions.

4) Functional Descriptions:

- User Features:
  - Search for available books in the inventory.
  - Add selected books to a virtual shopping cart.
  - Sign in to a personal account for a personalized experience.
  - Place orders for books in the cart.
  - Track the status of placed orders.

- Owner Features:
  - Add, edit, or remove book listings.
  - Manage publisher information and their book offerings.
  - Monitor sales performance and key performance indicators (KPIs).

- Publisher Features:
  - Receive commissions for sold books authored by them.
  - Receive notifications when book stock falls below a specified threshold.

5) Non-Functional Descriptions:

- The system should ensure a secure and user-friendly interface.
- Perform efficiently to handle numerous transactions and updates concurrently.
- Secure payment processing with industry-standard encryption.
- Scalable architecture to support growth in users and inventory.

-- Schema for database: schemabench_0192
CREATE TABLE `author` (
  `name` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  `picture` varchar(2047) DEFAULT NULL,
  `summary` varchar(2047) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `book` (
  `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(2047) DEFAULT NULL,
  `price` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL,
  `publisher_price` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL,
  `sold_count` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `isbn` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `series` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `format` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pages` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `coupon` (
  `coupon_code` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  `is_percent` tinyint(1) NOT NULL,
  `savings` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL,
  `valid_from` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `valid_to` timestamp NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`coupon_code`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `storeuser` (
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `first_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `last_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `address` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `picture` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `time_created` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `time_last_login` timestamp DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`username`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `product` (
  `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(2047) DEFAULT NULL,
  `price` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL,
  `publisher_price` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL,
  `sold_count` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `publisher` (
  `name` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  `address` varchar(2047) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone` bigint NOT NULL,
  `institution_number` smallint(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `branch_number` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `account_number` bigint NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `role` (
  `role_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(25) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(2047) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`role_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `warehouse` (
  `warehouse_name` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  `address` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone` bigint NOT NULL,
  `area_sqft` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`warehouse_name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `storeorder` (
  `order_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(80) DEFAULT NULL,
  `billed_to` varchar(2047) DEFAULT NULL,
  `shipped_to` varchar(2047) DEFAULT NULL,
  `time_placed` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `delivery_fee` decimal(8,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`order_number`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`username`) REFERENCES `storeuser` (`username`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `cart` (
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `last_edited` timestamp NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`username`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`username`) REFERENCES `storeuser` (`username`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `book_genre` (
  `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `genre` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`, `genre`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `book` (`product_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `product_image` (
  `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `image` varchar(2047) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`, `image`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `product` (`product_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `product_tag` (
  `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `tag` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`, `tag`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `product` (`product_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `cart_coupon` (
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `coupon_code` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`username`, `coupon_code`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`username`) REFERENCES `cart` (`username`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`coupon_code`) REFERENCES `coupon` (`coupon_code`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `cart_product` (
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `quantity` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`username`, `product_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`username`) REFERENCES `cart` (`username`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `product` (`product_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `order_coupon` (
  `order_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `coupon_code` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`order_number`, `coupon_code`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`order_number`) REFERENCES `storeorder` (`order_number`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`coupon_code`) REFERENCES `coupon` (`coupon_code`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `order_product` (
  `order_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `quantity` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `price` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`order_number`, `product_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`order_number`) REFERENCES `storeorder` (`order_number`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `product` (`product_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `publishes` (
  `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `publisher_name` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  `year_published` smallint(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reorder_threshold` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `commission_percent` decimal(5,3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`, `publisher_name`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `book` (`product_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`publisher_name`) REFERENCES `publisher` (`name`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `stored_in` (
  `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `warehouse_name` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  `stock` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `aisle` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`, `warehouse_name`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `product` (`product_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`warehouse_name`) REFERENCES `warehouse` (`warehouse_name`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `user_role` (
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `role_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`username`, `role_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`username`) REFERENCES `storeuser` (`username`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`role_id`) REFERENCES `role` (`role_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `writes` (
  `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `author_name` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`, `author_name`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `book` (`product_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`author_name`) REFERENCES `author` (`name`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
